headline: Spain has lost 393,000 rental homes between 2018 and 2025
summary: Long-term rental listings in Spain fell to 510,091 in 2025 from 902,664 in 2018, according to real estate portal idealista data cited by Italpress. The decline is attributed to regulatory measures.
why: Rental supply and rent regulation affect residential property valuations, landlord returns and the broader Spanish housing market.
